findings.title: co_applicant_empty_first_name_skips_only_guarantor_errors_test fixture falsified by the new required-cohort policy
findings.evidence: #("employment_status", "student") ... // Validate / parse alignment: zero guarantor copy on the re-render. The missing-fields banner copy is `form_copy.guarantor_missing_fields_error` ("we just need a few more details about the guarantor") — its absence here is the load-bearing assertion.
findings.detail: Primary applicant fixture is student — a REQUIRED cohort under the 2026-08-04 policy. The re-render now carries the requirement row + 6 primary guarantor errors; the test's 'zero guarantor copy' intent is false. It passes only because the load-bearing assertion checks a dead copy string (guarantor_missing_fields_error is unused). Sibling fixtures were migrated student→retired (draft/gdpr integration tests); this one was missed.
findings.recommended_fix: Migrate the fixture's primary employment_status to "retired" (like the gdpr/draft fixtures) so the test keeps isolating the co-applicant-card alignment behavior.

findings.title: Cohort flip after filling silently unchecks the box and wipes filled guarantor fields
findings.evidence: if (shouldHide && !el.hidden) clearInputsWithin(el); ... ctl.checked = false; ... ctl.value = ""; — gate div data-condition="_guarantor_required" data-condition-value="" wraps view_checkbox_field; fields div data-condition="_guarantor_fields_open" data-condition-value="on"
findings.detail: Optional applicant ticks box + fills 6 fields; picks student (gate hides → engine unchecks the box); switches back to employed (fields hide → clearInputsWithin wipes the filled values). Old code kept the tick and the data across cohort changes; the checkbox no longer reflects the applicant's actual last action.
findings.recommended_fix: Skip clearInputsWithin for the gate div (hide-only) and for the fields div when the cohort (not the box) drives the close, preserving filled values; or accept and document.

findings.title: Requirement row fires for filled-but-malformed guarantor fields, not just missing ones
findings.detail: A required cohort that names a guarantor with a malformed email/income still leads the banner with 'A guarantor is required — …' though one was provided. Partial-fill is pinned by test as intended; malformed is the same branch and reads odd.
findings.recommended_fix: Gate the requirement row on missing-name specifically (guarantor_name error present), or reword to 'A valid guarantor is required'.

findings.title: Required-cohort rule triplicated (handler / view mirror / JS mirror) with no cross-boundary agreement test
findings.evidence: pub fn guarantor_required(values) ... pub fn guarantor_cohort(...) ... function computeGuarantorCohort(...) — each with a 'MUST STAY IN SYNC' comment; tests pin each side independently (truth_table, cohort_mirror_agrees, form_guarantor_cohort.test.js), none pins agreement across boundaries.
findings.detail: The spec's core invariant — ONE rule feeding validation, persistence, consent, and rendering — has no test that would fail on a one-sided drift (e.g. adding a cohort to the handler only).
findings.recommended_fix: Add one cross-cutting unit test asserting handler.guarantor_required ⇔ common.guarantor_cohort_is_required ⇔ JS computeGuarantorCohort for the full status matrix.

findings.title: Guarantor-step required notices + retired hint lack unit render pins (E2E-only coverage)
findings.evidence: grep 'guarantor-required-notice|guarantor-retired-hint' server/test scripts/js-tests → zero matches; guarantor_section_test pins only the _guarantor_* synthetics + checkbox state
findings.detail: The declared-required notices (data-testid=guarantor-required-notice-*) and the retired hint — the core of the two-path render — are only asserted by bug-hunt E2E scenarios, which require a live server.
findings.recommended_fix: Add SSR pins in guarantor_section_test asserting the notice elements + data-condition wiring render for each cohort.
